description_en: Retrieves the information of a single origin address pool by origin address pool ID
description_zh: 根据源地址池ID获取单条源地址池信息
name: GetOriginPool

parameters.help_en: The origin address pool ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863947.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863947.html接口获取
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: site_id

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the origin address pool is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
源地址池是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用

Name.description_en: The name of the origin address pool. The name must be unique within a site
Name.description_zh: 源地址池名称，一个站点下源地址池名称唯一

Origins.description_en: The information about the origin servers added to the origin address pool
Origins.description_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息

items.description_en: The information about the origin servers added to the origin address pool
items.description_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息

Address.description_en: The addresses of the origin server, such as www.example.com. If Type is set to tunnel_route, this parameter indicates the ID of the referenced tunnel routing
Address.description_zh: 源站地址，如：www.example.com。Type为tunnel_route时，为所引用的隧道路由ID

AuthConf.description_en: The authentication information. If the origin server is OSS or S3 and requires authentication, you must pass the authentication configuration information
AuthConf.description_zh: 鉴权信息，源站为OSS或者S3等源站需要鉴权时，需要传鉴权相关配置信息

AccessKey.description_en: The AccessKey required when AuthType is set to private_cross_account or private

AuthType.description_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

public: Public read/write. Used when the origin server is OSS or S3 and has public read/write permissions.
private_same_account: Private same-account. Used when the origin server is OSS and the authentication type is same-account private authentication.
private_cross_account: Private cross-account. Used when the origin server is OSS and the authentication type is cross-account private authentication.
private: Private. Used when the origin server is S3 and the authentication type is private
AuthType.description_zh:
鉴权类型。

public：公共读写，源站为OSS或S3且为公共读写时使用；
private_same_account：私有同账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为同账号私有鉴权时使用；
private_cross_account：私有跨账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为跨账号私有鉴权时使用；
private：源站为S3，且鉴权类型为私有时使用

Region.description_en: The region of the origin server required when the origin server is AWS S3
Region.description_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的源站Region

SecretKey.description_en: The SecretKey required when AuthType is set to private_cross_account or private

Version.description_en: The signature version required when the origin server is AWS S3
Version.description_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的签名版本

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the origin server is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
源站是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用

Header.description_en: The request header included in back-to-origin requests. Only Host is supported
Header.description_zh: 回源时带的请求头，只支持Host

Id.description_en: The ID of the origin server

InnerType.description_en: The internal type of the origin server. This parameter is read-only and generated by the server. If Type is set to tunnel_route, tunnel_route is returned
InnerType.description_zh: 源站内部类型，只读，由服务端生成。Type为tunnel_route时返回tunnel_route

IpVersionPolicy.description_en:
The IP protocol version used for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:
round_robin: Default policy. Randomly polls IPv4 or IPv6 origin servers.
ipv4_first: Prioritizes IPv4 origin servers.
ipv6_first: Prioritizes IPv6 origin servers.
follow: Prioritizes the IP version used by the client
IpVersionPolicy.description_zh:
回源请求使用的 IP 协议版本：
round_robin：默认策略，随机轮询 IPv4 或 IPv6 源站
ipv4_first：优先使用 IPv4 源站
ipv6_first：优先使用 IPv6 源站
follow：优先跟随客户端使用的 IP 版本

Name.description_en: The name of the origin server

SourceInfo.description_en: The source information of the origin server. This parameter is read-only. If Type is set to tunnel_route, the server queries and populates this parameter based on the tunnel route ID in Address. You do not need to specify this parameter when creating or updating an origin server
SourceInfo.description_zh: 源站来源信息，只读。Type为tunnel_route时，服务端根据Address中的隧道路由ID查询并补齐，创建或修改源站时无需传入

Endpoint.description_en: The identifier of the cloud resource of the tunnel route, such as the instance ID, bucket name, IP address, or domain name
Endpoint.description_zh: 隧道路由的云资源标识，如实例ID、Bucket名称、IP或域名

Region.description_en: The region where the cloud resource of the tunnel route is located
Region.description_zh: 隧道路由的云资源所在地域

TunnelRouteId.description_en: The ID of the referenced tunnel route

Type.description_en: The cloud resource type of the tunnel route, such as ECS or NLB. This is different from the tunnel_route value of the origin server Type
Type.description_zh: 隧道路由的云资源类型，如ECS、NLB等，与源站Type的取值tunnel_route不同

VSwitchIds.description_en: The list of vSwitch IDs specified for the tunnel route. This parameter is empty if not specified
VSwitchIds.description_zh: 隧道路由指定的交换机ID列表，未指定时为空

VpcId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance specified for the tunnel routing. This parameter is empty if not specified
VpcId.description_zh: 隧道路由指定的VPC实例ID，未指定时为空

VpcTunnelId.description_en: The ID of the VPC tunnel to which the tunnel route belongs

Type.description_en:
The type of the origin server. Valid values:

ip_domain: IP address or domain name origin server.
OSS: OSS address origin server.
S3: AWS S3 origin server.
tunnel_route: Tunnel route origin server. For the actual cloud resource type, see SourceInfo.Type
Type.description_zh:
源站类型：

ip_domain: ip或域名类型源站；
OSS：OSS地址源站；
S3：AWS S3源站；
tunnel_route：隧道路由源站，实际云资源类型见SourceInfo.Type

Weight.description_en: The weight. Valid values: integers from 0 to 100

RecordName.description_en: The domain name allocated to the origin IPAM pool, which can be used as the addresses of the origin server for records under the site
RecordName.description_zh: 为源地址池分配的域名，可以用来作站点下记录的源站地址

ReferenceLBCount.description_en: The number of load balancing that reference this origin IPAM pool
ReferenceLBCount.description_zh: 被多少个负载均衡器引用

References.description_en: The reference information of the origin IPAM pool. An origin IPAM pool is considered referenced when it is configured in load balancing or configured as an origin server in a record
References.description_zh: 源地址池被引用信息，源地址池被负载均衡器配置或者被记录配置为源站时，被认为是引用

DnsRecords.description_en: The list of Layer 7 records that use this origin address pool as the origin server
DnsRecords.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的七层记录列表

items.description_en: The information about the Layer 7 record that uses this origin address pool as the origin server
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的七层记录信息

IPARecords.description_en: The list of Layer 4 records that use this origin address pool as the origin server
IPARecords.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的四层记录列表

items.description_en: The information about the Layer 4 record that uses this origin address pool as the origin server
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的四层记录信息

LoadBalancers.description_en: The list of load balancing that use this origin IPAM pool
LoadBalancers.description_zh: 使用此源地址池的负载均衡器列表

items.description_en: The information about the load balancing that uses this origin IPAM pool
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池的负载均衡器信息

SiteId.description_en: The ID of the site to which the origin address pool belongs
